line_items.label: Total Gross Sales Turnover (GMV)
line_items.note: Total invoiced sales value across all active channels before deductions.

line_items.label: Less: Returns & Customer Refunds
line_items.note: Value of units returned and refunded to customers.

line_items.label: Net Realized Sales Turnover
line_items.note: Net sales after discounts (net sales) and customer refunds.

line_items.label: Less: COGS
line_items.note: Direct product cost of goods sold.

line_items.label: Less: Total Marketing & Ad Spend
line_items.note: Total advertising spend across all platforms.

line_items.label: Less: Marketplace Commission & Logistics
line_items.note: Platform fees, shipping, and payment-processing costs.

line_items.label: GRAND NET OPERATING PROFIT (EBITDA)
line_items.note: Operating profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization.
